title: Modelling simple and complex metal-oxide and -hydroxide surface structures using their point of zero charge
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25772-25786
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00388E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Miriam Leffler, Steven L. Suib
This work models the global surface structure of simple and complex aqueous metal oxides and hydroxides at the solid/liquid interface. A variable was included for the material's ionic content in a model originally used for predicting the point of zero charge.
